_note: NO-RUN — the PM session overwrites this file after a real desk run; until then it is deliberately empty. It is NOT a desk run and NOT a live on-chain snapshot: every brokerage section (account, positions, candidates, orders, backtests) is EMPTY and every on-chain figure is null, so nothing here is simulated or faked. The only real data in this file is the deployed contract addresses on Robinhood Chain mainnet (chainId 4663): the dashboard reads those contracts live and shows a figure only when the read succeeds — otherwise the panel stays empty. Mainnet · no third-party audit · deposits capped at 10,000 USDG · no deposits and no trades yet, so there is no track record.
